opening_title: Handle warnings raised at import time early in pytest process

expected_outcome.rationale: Warnings escaping filtering during early imports differ from log_disable not being supported in ini. The opening reports pytest 8.1.1 on Linux without an OS release or complete package list; the warning output and invocation do not include an isolated module reproducer. Bug is accepted for failure to control warnings; enhancement would also be defensible.
